about.role: Lead Designer / Brand, campaign & digital design
about.intro:
I'm a Tokyo-based designer working across brand identity, licensed merchandise, campaigns and digital experiences.

I take projects from the first concept through production and launch, combining art direction and hands-on design with web development. My work spans entertainment IP, independent brands and my own game, Wheels of Steel.
about.experience:
Independent / Freelance — Designer & Web Developer | 2019–Present | Visual identities, album artwork, promotional campaigns and bilingual websites for clients.
Tokyo Dub Agent — Lead Designer | 2023–2026 | Led design across licensed merchandise, websites, campaigns and live events. Projects included Attack on Titan, Ghost in the Shell and Cowboy Bebop collaborations, alongside every AKIBA EDEN LOT collection during my tenure.
about.skills:
Design | Brand identity, art direction, merchandise, campaign graphics and motion
Tools | Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Blender
Web & games | Responsive websites, WordPress, Shopify, Next.js and Unity
Languages | English (native); Japanese (conversational)
